source.description:
Word was sent here from Darnassus, <name>. It seems one of your priestesses wants you to return home. Speak to Priestess Alathea at the Temple of the Moon whenever you're able. It seems she is pleased with your progress. I am sure she takes great pride in seeing one of Elune's servants take such great strides in <his/her> faith.

The Light be with you.
